questions.prompt: Which characters start a single-line comment in C#?
questions.explanation: The // characters start a single-line comment that ends at the line break.

questions.prompt: Which pair of symbols delimits a block comment?
questions.explanation: Block comments are enclosed by /* and */.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank to open a multi-line comment
What is the main benefit of XML documentation comments?
options: IDE IntelliSense support and API documentation
questions.explanation: XML doc comments provide descriptions that tools and IDEs display to developers using your code.

questions.prompt: Add a single-line comment on its own line that says 'review' and still print OK
Can block comments be nested in C#?
options: No, once /* starts, the next */ ends it
questions.explanation: Nested block comments are not allowed. The first */ closes the comment.

questions.prompt: Arrange the XML doc comment for a method named Add
questions.explanation: XML doc comments use tags like <summary>, <param>, and <returns> to document the method.

questions.prompt: Which XML doc tag provides a brief description of a method?
questions.explanation: <summary> provides a concise description that appears in IntelliSense.

What happens to comments when the program runs?
options: They are ignored by the compiler and do not affect execution
They are stored in the executable
questions.explanation: Comments are completely ignored by the compiler and stripped from the compiled output.
